summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for Admin Program calendar metrics and Admin Drivers management. Core requested flows passed end-to-end (ranking patch/admin-only guard, protected driver delete with STERGE, active-order delete block, program week metrics visible, slot creation actions, admin login and tab navigation). One auth/CORS defect remains.

critical.issue: Preflight still returns `access-control-allow-origin: *` while credentials are enabled; expected explicit origin echo for credentialed requests.

action_items: Fix credentialed CORS preflight so allowed origin is explicit (not wildcard `*`) at effective runtime edge.
Re-run iteration23 backend suite after CORS fix to close remaining failure.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/backend/routers/seed.py` still deletes/recreates all collections; this is not an idempotent 'update existing admin if password changed' seed strategy.
`/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx` is oversized (>700 LOC), reducing maintainability and targeted testability.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used admin@delivery.ro/admin123 plus driver role for authorization checks.
seed_data_creation: Triggered via POST /api/seed in pytest module fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI smoke and requested admin flows are currently functional on public preview URL. Temporary UI-created driver was deleted successfully. Remaining blocker is only credentialed CORS preflight wildcard response.
rca of the issue: RCA: Although backend middleware is configured for explicit allowlist origins, runtime OPTIONS /api/auth/login still responds with wildcard ACAO (`*`), indicating ingress/proxy or middleware ordering mismatch for preflight handling. Repro: send OPTIONS with Origin=https://delivery-dispatch-17.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method=POST; observe ACAO='*'. Mitigation: enforce explicit origin reflection at final response layer handling preflight for auth routes.
